steps: Boil or pressure cook the potato and beetroot until soft, then peel them.
Grate the potato, beetroot and paneer into a bowl.
Dry roast the cumin, crush it, and chop the coriander leaves fine.
Mix everything with the oats into a soft dough.
Shape into 4 small, flat rounds that a small hand can hold.
Heat the oil in a flat pan and cook the tikkis on medium-low heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
Let them cool a little before serving.
note: No salt, chilli or chaat masala. Paneer helps bind and oats take the place of breadcrumbs or sooji.
